name: Frostbound
source: Pathfinder Howl of the Wild, Frostbound adjustment (pg. 122), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/MonsterTemplates.aspx?ID=25
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder Howl of the Wild is ORC licensed material.
rules: Adds resistance to cold and weakness to fire 3, 5, 10 or 15 by level (3 or lower, 4-8, 9-13, 14+), and Freezing Adaptation, Winter Senses, Arctic Steps and Snow Spray.

abilities.name: Winter Senses
abilities.description: {Name} ignores concealment caused by ice or snow.

abilities.name: Freezing Adaptation
abilities.description: {Name} treats environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).

abilities.name: Arctic Steps
abilities.description: {Name} ignores uneven ground and difficult terrain caused by ice and the difficult terrain caused by snow (reducing greater difficult terrain from ice or snow to ordinary difficult terrain).

abilities.name: Snow Spray
abilities.description: Requirements {Name} is standing on or adjacent to loose snow; Effect {Name} kicks up the snow, becoming concealed to all creatures that are not adjacent to it until it moves or the end of its next turn.
